promises.label: Capacity for smartphones and notebooks in HKC JV Phase 1
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: In the first phase of a 74:26 JV with HKC for display modules, we are creating a capacity of 24 million per annum for smartphones and 2 million units per annum for notebooks, which would be for 76% of captive consumption.

promises.label: Capacity for smartphones, LED TVs and automotive in HKC JV Phase 2
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: In the second phase, we will enhance this capacity to 60 million units per annum for smartphones, which will account for almost 80% of the captive consumption. And we will also foray into display for LED TVs and automotive with a capacity of 2 million and 1 million units per annum, respectively.

promises.label: Display segment margins
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: The margins in this segment will be in higher double digits.

promises.label: Smartphone camera modules revenue potential in 2 to 3 years
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: And we feel confident that the volume of smartphone camera modules can increase from 40 million units and revenues by INR 2,000 crores in large financial years to 190 to 200 million units per annum with the revenue closer to INR 6,000 crores to INR 7,000 crores and sub-10% EBITDA margins in the next two to three years.

promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We have filed a components ECMS applications for display modules, camera module enclosures, lithium-ion batteries, optical transceiver - SFP and also mechanical enclosures with investment commitment of approximately INR 3,000 crores over the next three years.

promises.label: JV with Longcheer facility operational date
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We have received the PN3 approval for 74:26 joint venture with Longcheer and have finalized a new 400,000 square feet facility for the JV, which is expected to be operational by April '26 and PN3 appraisal process for 51:49 JV with Vivo and 74:26 JV with HKC is progressing well, and we expect the approvals in the coming weeks.

promises.label: Manufacturing start for new ODM smartphone customer

promises.label: Rexxam Chennai facility operational date

promises.label: Longcheer JV volumes for next fiscal
promises.speaker: Atul Lall

promises.label: IT business target in next two years
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We feel that the IT business for us in next two years should be around Rs. 4,000 crores to Rs. 5,000 crores business.

promises.label: Sales target in next 3 to 4 years
promises.speaker: Atul Lall
promises.quote: We feel confident about it.
